models.name: Qwen3.8-27B (TeksEdge DFlash2 + lookup, RTX 3090)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B (TeksEdge inference-stack tuning on a single RTX 3090)

engines.quant: DFlash2 speculative decoding + context lookup + optimized lookup verification, prefix caching, quantized KV; progression 82 -> 114 (optimized MTP) -> 138 (DFlash2 + lookup) -> 381 tok/s, same GPU, entirely inference-stack work
same 82 -> 381 tok/s stack progression reported on the developer's own thread (445 likes); context-lookup verification is the step that takes 138 to 381

models.why: 82 to 381 tok/s on the same single RTX 3090, with no hardware change: DFlash2 plus context lookup and longer verification blocks, and the clearest evidence in the set that the serving stack, not the card, sets the ceiling for a 27B dense model.
